meaning: The GTK about page reads these facts locally in agathodaimon/gui/plugs/about_system.py:20-189. No Caduceus door serves this act yet. Window Manager from the GTK session environment and Resolution from its Gdk monitors belong to the GTK session alone; the future door will not answer them.

born.meaning: First ten characters of the recorded born_at date, or empty.

local_ip.meaning: Local IPv4 address from the UDP routing probe, or empty.

operating_system.meaning: Operating system pretty name and machine architecture.

packages.meaning: Installed package count and manager, or empty.

uptime.meaning: Formatted days, hours and minutes, or empty.

model.meaning: DMI product name and meaningful version.

processor.meaning: CPU model and logical count when found, otherwise platform processor.

graphics.meaning: PCI display controllers as title and device pairs, ordered by PCI address; an empty Graphics row when none found.

memory.meaning: Used and total memory in MiB, or empty.

disk.meaning: Used and total root filesystem space in GiB, or empty.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: No Caduceus door serves this act yet, so it answers no fixed signal today.
